items.information: Please read all the information in the **FAQ** and the **Important Information** tabs before registering. **Spectators may attend for free. There is no need to book!** **Dual Rounds** This competition will use Dual Rounds for 3x3 and FTO so **everyone** will have the opportunity to set **at least 2 averages.** The winner of **FTO** will be announced as the winner of the competition.
